disposition_reason: New FAAS measurements of metals released into infusions of five wild medicinal plants are printed in Table 3; wild food and geophagic concentrations in Table 1 are quoted from the authors' companion paper.
disposition_locator: Table 3, p. 11; Table 1 source note p. 9

study.origin: wild-harvested in the Great Dyke (SUG) and surrounding granitic (GG) areas, Zimbabwe
study.method: FAAS (GBC Savant) on infusion supernatants; ingestion rates from key informants
